title: spawn_fx_init/spawn_fx_destroy remain dead code; Spawn_FX.reveals still latches the ambient allocator and leaks (r1 W3 unaddressed in r3)
detail: The init/destroy lifecycle is still never wired; the zero-value View.spawn_fx self-allocates reveals on first append via the tracking allocator and never frees — the same leak-noise class the PR's growth_test fold removed from core.
recommended_fix: Either call spawn_fx_init/spawn_fx_destroy from the app View setup/teardown and harness Render_Ctx lifecycle, or delete both procs and document the latch-on-append pattern.

title: Feed test slices only the tick's LAST event, assuming NODE_SPAWNED is final — step emits post-growth events after the spawn, so the pin can break spuriously
evidence:
test:
	before := len(s.events) - 1 // the last event is the t80 NODE_SPAWNED
	_ = before
	slice := s.events[before:]
core/step.odin ordering (growth runs mid-step, more events follow):
123:			event_emit(state, tick, EVENT_TAG_NODE_SPAWNED)
153:	flow_step(state, tick, cat)        // appends Packet_Arrived/Packet_Dropped after the spawn
161:	warning_evaluate(state, tick, cat)  // appends Warning_Raised/Cleared after the spawn
detail: The slice covers exactly one event; it contains a NODE_SPAWNED only while no post-growth system fires at the window tick. Any future arrival/warning event at t80 silently empties the slice and fails the pin for unrelated reasons.
recommended_fix: Scan backwards for the last EVENT_TAG_NODE_SPAWNED and slice from that index (or feed the full tick slice), removing the last-event assumption.
